name: Yeekit – Signature Field for Gravity Forms
author: add-ons.org

sections.description:
Pro Version: https://add-ons.org/plugin/gravity-forms-signature-field/
Document: https://add-ons.org/document-gravity-forms-signature/

Yeekit – Signature Field for Gravity Forms allows you to easily capture digital signatures online. Captured signatures are saved as secure images, displayed in entry details, embeddable via merge tags, and can be automatically attached to email notifications.

It supports all modern web browsers, desktop mice, stylus pens, and touch-based mobile devices (iOS, iPadOS, Android, and Windows).

Features

  • Easy to Use: Add the Signature field directly from the “Advanced Fields” toolbox in the Gravity Forms editor.
  • Touchscreen & Mouse Support: Responsive, smooth drawing canvas that works on mobile phones, tablets, and desktop computers.
  • WordPress Core Touch-Punch Integration: Uses native WordPress touch support for ultra-fast, smooth signing without heavy dependencies.
  • Customizable Appearance: Customize width, height, stroke color, background color, and background guidelines to match your form branding.
  • Full Name Capture: Optional full name input field alongside the signature pad.
  • Clear & Redo Button: One-click clear button for users to sign again if needed.
  • Email Notifications & Attachments: Automatically attach signature images to notification emails or insert them using standard Gravity Forms merge tags.
  • Entry Detail & List View: View, inspect, and download signatures in the WordPress admin under Gravity Forms Entries.
  • AJAX & Multi-Page Compatible: Fully compatible with Gravity Forms AJAX submissions, multi-step forms, and conditional logic.
  • PDF Ready: Easily embed signature images into generated PDF agreements, contracts, and invoices.

Pro Version

  • Full color palette and custom styling
  • Background watermark / guideline customization
  • Advanced export and PDF integration features
  • 30-day money-back guarantee
  • 1-year dedicated support & updates
sections.installation:
1. Upload the yeekit-signature-field-for-gravity-forms directory to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Edit any form in Gravity Forms, open the Advanced Fields tab, and drag the Signature field into your form.
  4. Configure field width, height, and color in the field settings panel.
  5. Save your form and start collecting signatures online!
sections.changelog:
3.0.0

  • Security: Strictly sanitize and escape all field settings, HTML attributes, and inline CSS styles to prevent CSS injection and XSS.
  • Improved: Fully comply with WordPress.org storage guidelines by saving signature files and security files in dedicated plugin directory resolved at runtime via wp_upload_dir().
  • Improved: Fully comply with WordPress.org coding and asset enqueueing standards.
  • Improved: Replaced inline style tags with wp_add_inline_style() and wp_enqueue_style().
  • Improved: Replaced direct server paths with proper URLs for frontend assets.
  • Fixed: Resolved script registration and localization issues.

2.8.7

  • Improved: Fully compatible with Gravity Forms 2.5 – 2.8+ and WordPress 6.7+.
  • Improved: Uses WordPress core jquery-touch-punch for enhanced performance.
  • Improved: Replaced inline scripts with dedicated editor script file.
  • Improved: Form Editor preview displays mockup signature placeholder instead of heavy canvas.
  • Fixed: Resolved AddOn loader class naming conflict.
  • Fixed: Added support for yeekit_signature field type and notification attachments.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
